original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-dg-hull}
Let $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$ be a ringed site.
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a sheaf of differential graded algebras
on $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{O})$. The forgetful functor
$F : \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d}) \to \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A})$
has a left adjoint $G : \textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}) \to
\textit{Mod}(\mathcal{A}, \text{d})$.

semantic_review_note: For a sheaf of differential graded algebras, the forgetful functor from DG A-modules to graded A-modules admits a LEFT adjoint, the DG hull. The direction of the adjunction and both module categories remain.
